text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This 
 document outlines the equipment inspection list I2, which must be performed 
 every three months as indicated by M3 in the above titled block.
This compressor serves in compressing air for 
 self-cleaning system which is using in cleaning the Gas Turbine GT air filters and HRSG 
 'Heat Recovery Steam Generator' inlet damper to control opening and closing.
The first 
 draft is initiated by eng. Saad Samra, tested by eng. Mohamed Abdel Azeem, 
 revised by EDEPC. 
 Inspection and Quality control eng Abouda Elbanna and accepted by General 
 manager eng. Mohamed Elsarrag and approved by eng. Moneer Mahmoud 
 El-Wakeel; Head Sector of Damietta PS.
Technical 
specification
 | Type of the 
 compressor | : | Atlas 
 Copco GA 
 345-10
 | Max. unloading Pressure | : | 9 bars .
 | Min working 
 pressure | : | 4 bars.
 | Max inlet 
 temperature | : | 30 C .
 | Motor shaft 
 speed | : | 2955 r.p.m.
Safety Precautions
Disconnect the power supply of the compressor.
Isolate the compressor mechanically.
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance stuff should be carry the
 suitable 
 safety category .
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area .
Wear your safety helmet, shoes, 
 and gloves pairs.
Disconnect the power supply of the compressor.
Isolate the compressor mechanically.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Compressed air hose.
Cleaning articles (fluid, rags etc).
Soft brushes,
 Spray gun.
Work to be Carried Out
Check safety valve.
Inspect cooler for leaks, clean 
 it if necessary
Remove air filter element and 
 also small air filter. Clean by air jet , inspect and change the damage one.
Remove, dismantle and clean 
 float valve of moisture trap.
Change the oil of the 
 compressor if the oil lost its good specifications.
Check the oil filter, and 
 change it if it is necessary.
Inspect the coupling to check 
 the rubber joint and tightening of the bolts.
